notes.title: Exteria Steam Release
notes.notes:
After a long, exiting, but also difficult journey Exteria has finally been released on Steam today! 
During the launch week the game will cost $1,19 with the 40% discount applied. Afterwards it will be sold for it's regular price of $1.99.

"Exteria is an old school fantasy first person shooter. Play through the short story and fight for a highscore in survival mode! "

The next step will be to release the Steam Trading Cards. However it's hard to predict when they will be released, as Valve will have to approve them first. Another announcement will be posted here, when the Trading Cards are available.
